page: Vultr vcg-a40-6c-30g-12vram is a Cloud GPU instance configured with the x86_64 architecture. It features 6 dedicated Intel vCPUs and 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 5.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with a fractional NVIDIA Ampere A40 GPU, representing a 0.25 slice of the physical graphics processor, which provides 12 GB of dedicated VRAM.
Local storage is provided via a 550 GB NVMe SSD, offering high-speed solid-state storage directly attached to the instance. The configuration also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

By utilizing a fractional GPU allocation, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full, dedicated physical GPU. The resource density balances 6 dedicated Intel vCPUs with 30 GB of RAM, mitigating the underutilization of hardware resources for smaller-scale parallel processing tasks.

This server configuration is suitable for workloads such as small-scale machine learning inference, data science prototyping, video transcoding, and moderately demanding graphics rendering tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration and NVMe storage.
